design: One fixed image-only detector bundle; same four crops and six windows; three simple selectors per detector; no graph/context change.
inference_inventory_contract: Expose only these unmarked PNG/frame/source bindings and the model contract to inference; no labels, review manifests, overlays, player/court data or source-video decoding.

model.resize_mode: Fixed square letterbox: 1152x648 -> 640x360 content, 140px top/bottom padding; BGR array -> RGB tensor, /255; preserve inverse transform.
model.nms_backend: torchvision.ops.nms; import and assert torchvision before postprocessing; runtime versions and device pinned
model.timeout_policy: Capture and reject any NMS timeout warning or partial/error output; no valid checkpoint on failure.
model.cap_policy: Record postprocessor count before export floor and whether count equals300; saturation is a diagnostic, not proof of exact truncation count.
model.candidate_semantics: Postprocessed best-class-only sports-ball candidates after per-view NMS/cap; not raw head/channel proposals.
model.training_provenance: Official COCO-pretrained80class checkpoint; exact source-footage overlap unverified; inspect embedded metadata without inventing missing history.
model.warmup_policy: Every fresh predictor must complete initialization/warmup on synthetic non-project pixels before project data; never warm up on a project crop. Count synthetic forwards, project attempts/retries and600unique completed units separately.

comparison_limits: Full detector configurations differ in model, resize/normalization, best-class policy, candidate budget and NMS; no architecture-only attribution.
Absent exported matches cannot separate score/class-assignment/suppression/internal-cap causes.
Confidence scores are not calibrated across detector families.
Same150repeatedly inspected development frames; no independent-trial or unseen-game generalization claim.
Wrong at a radius is not a semantic non-ball label; preserve reviewed annotation uncertainty.
global_candidate_order: confidence_desc, global_bbox_xyxy_lexicographic, view_ordinal, local_candidate_index; assign contiguous global candidate indices
cross_crop_duplicate_policy: Retain all; no global NMS or deduplication.
selector_contract: Inclusive original-confidence filter, then confidence descending/global index ascending; no fabricated output on empty frames.
matching_rule: Existing raw-center-distance matching; uncertainty diagnostic only.
metrics: per-crop exported count and cap saturation
runtime_preconditions: Dedicated ignored environment; baseline environment unchanged.
Exact resolved dependency inventory plus wheel/source hashes; package and weight pins verified before model loading.
Synthetic/focused/full tests and non-project-frame runtime compatibility checks.
Class mapping/task/stride/precision/backend validation, preserving unknown training provenance.
Evidence-bound experiment approval and separately authorized clean tested code commit.
Freeze runtime evidence before any real project-frame call; no silent contract substitution.
Verify warmup already completed on synthetic inputs for each predictor before admitting project pixels; assert one forward per ordinary project attempt and record all retries.

draft_refinement.reason: Independent review identified implicit first-input warmup; require synthetic-only initialization and distinguish uniqueunits from attempts.
